setupStepNote_profile: Name, language, time zone and how you want to be contacted.
setupStepNote_users: Invite operations and finance colleagues and set their roles.
setupStepNote_addresses: Shippers, consignees and delivery points, so quote requests prefill instead of retyping.
setupStepNote_alerts: Departure, arrival, delay, documents requested and free-time expiry, by email or in the portal.

starterNote_quote: One form for sea, air and road, including dangerous goods, temperature control and out-of-gauge cargo.
starterNote_team: Add operations and finance colleagues, give each the roles they need, and restrict by office if you want.
starterNote_track: Follow a shipment by container, bill of lading, air waybill, booking or purchase order.
listNote_shipments: Live and recent moves on your linked offices
listEmptyNote_shipments: As soon as a booking is confirmed it appears here with milestones, documents and a predicted arrival.
listNote_quotations: Requests with pricing, and options awaiting your decision
listEmptyNote_quotations: Send a lane to your pricing team. They reply with options you can compare, accept and book here.
listEmptyNote_bookings: Accepting a quotation creates a booking. Invoices and credit notes follow automatically for users with finance access.
dashSubtitle: {{inFlight}} shipments in flight across {{offices}}, {{arriving}} arriving in the next ten days.

dashNeedsYouNote_other: {{count}} items are waiting on your side. Everything else sits with your Noatum office.

dashStage_in_transit: On the water or in the air

dashTransitNote: What was quoted against what happened, in days.
dashLanesNote: Where the volume and the money sit.
dashSpendSplitNote: {{total}} in the period, by charge group.
dashUnavailableNote: Your account cannot see the analytics dashboard, or it is switched off for this environment. Everything else in the portal is unaffected.
qiMedianNote: From your request to priced options
qiWaitingTitle: Waiting on you or on us
qiWaitingNote: Open requests, soonest expiry first. Prices hold only until the validity date.
qiWaitingEmpty: Nothing is waiting. Every request you have sent has been answered and decided.
qiRateEmpty: No priced lane to compare yet.
qiSpeedTitle: How fast you get a price
qiSpeedNote: Median time from request to options, last 12 months
qiInstantLede: of your requests were priced instantly from contract rates. The rest go to your pricing desk.
qiRecentEmpty: You have not requested a quotation yet.
qiReuseNote: Open a lane you have used and send it again
qiNeedMore: Need something the form does not cover?
accessNote: Only records on your linked organisations are visible to you, and only those your role permits.
trackNote: Works from your first booking. Older references stay with your Noatum office until re-evaluation finishes.
trackPlaceholder: Container, B/L, AWB, booking or PO
trackNoRecord: No record for {{reference}} on your account yet.
customerHeroLede: This is where you will track Air and Sea shipments, request and accept quotations, and download your documents. Sections appear here as they are released to your account.
customerSectionsNote: Your Noatum office sets up each section for your account. We will tell you when one becomes available.
customerSection_shipments: Follow a container, bill of lading or air waybill in transit, with milestones and documents.
customerSection_quotations: Ask your Noatum office to price a lane, then review and accept the quotation here.
customerSection_invoices: View and download the invoices addressed to your company.
customerContactNote: Your Noatum office can help with anything this portal does not yet cover. Use the contact you already have for your account.
customerSignInNote: Tracking, quotations and invoices are available once you sign in. Access is by invitation from your company administrator.
publicLede: Enter a container, bill of lading, air waybill or booking reference for a status summary.
publicLedeSecond: Documents, financials and full milestone history need a portal account.
publicTrackNote: One reference at a time. Public results are rate limited and never show parties, prices or documents.
publicTrackPending: Public tracking is not connected yet. Sign in to follow a shipment, or ask your Noatum office for a status update.
publicBenefitsNote: Public tracking answers one question. The portal runs the whole shipment.
publicBenefitNote_visibility: Filter by state, lane or office, with predictive ETA and delay alerts instead of one reference at a time.
publicBenefitNote_quote: Request a rate, compare the options your office prices, accept and book without leaving the portal.
publicBenefitNote_paperwork: Bills of lading, packing lists, certificates and invoices per shipment, downloadable by your finance team.
publicBenefitNote_alerts: Email or in-portal alerts on departure, arrival, delay, documents requested and free-time expiry.
publicRequestNote: Your Noatum office links your company’s organisations, then invites your first administrator, who invites colleagues. Tell us who you are and we will come back to you.
publicWorkEmailNote: Personal email domains are not accepted
publicReferenceNote: Speeds up matching your company to our records
publicPrivacy: We use these details only to verify your company against our records. No account is created until your office confirms.
publicRequestPending: Not open yet. Ask your Noatum office to invite you.
publicInvitedStep1: Open the invitation link your Noatum office emailed you. It is single-use and expires after 7 days.
publicInvitedStep2: Sign in with Microsoft. Your identity is verified there; the portal decides what your company may see.
publicInvitedStep3: Lost or expired link? Your own Customer Admin can resend it, or ask your Noatum office.
customerFirstRunLede: You are the {{role}} for {{customer}}. Nothing is in flight here yet: new shipments, quotations and invoices on your linked offices appear automatically. A few short steps make the portal useful on day one.
customerFirstRunNote: Your Noatum office enables each section for your account. We will tell you when one becomes available.
co2Blurb: Open to everyone. Estimate emissions on a lane before you talk to us. Indicative, GLEC-aligned, not a certified emissions statement.
co2ModeUnserved: {{mode}} is not served on this lane
co2Basis: Sea uses container-ship averages, air uses belly-freight averages, road uses a 40 t articulated truck and rail uses electrified intermodal. Change the weight to match your shipment.
co2Compare: Same cargo, same lane, other modes
co2IsLowest: This is the lowest-emission mode on the lane · {{mode}} would emit about {{ratio}}× more.
co2CouldSave: Switching to {{mode}} would cut about {{saving}} kg CO₂e, at a longer transit.
co2OneModeOnly: Only one mode is served on this lane.
co2Disclaimer: Well-to-wheel estimates from lane distance, mode and default load factors, using GLEC-aligned intensity values. Actual emissions depend on carrier, vessel or aircraft, routing and utilisation. Not a certified emissions statement.
publicSignInForRestNote: Documents, exact event times, parties, invoices, email alerts and the full milestone history are available to portal users on this shipment's account.
publicWorkEmailInvalid: Enter a valid company email address
publicRequestReceivedNote: Our Valencia office replies within one business day. If your company already uses the portal, your own administrator can invite you immediately.
publicRatesNote: Search sea, air and road services on your lane, compare price against transit and CO₂e, then ask your Noatum office for a firm quotation.
publicMilestoneNote: Public milestones come from carrier and terminal messages and may lag the physical move.
publicLookingNote: Checking the carrier and terminal messages we hold for this reference.
publicMissNote: References appear once the carrier or terminal issues the first message, usually within a day of booking. Check the number, or if it is a Noatum booking, sign in or contact your local office.
publicTrackFailedNote: We could not reach the tracking service. Nothing is wrong with your reference — try again in a moment.
publicRequestFailedNote: Check the company name and email address and try again, or write to the office address below.
publicSampleData: Sample data — the public tracking service is not connected yet
co2Unavailable: The emissions service is unavailable right now.
publicMissWrongKind: That reference exists, but not under the type you selected.
teamLede: The people at your company who can use this portal, and what each of them can do. You invite them; Noatum does not need to.
teamPeopleNote: Everyone with an account on your company, including those who have not signed in yet.
teamPendingNote: Invitations that have been sent but not yet used. Each link works once.
teamNoPending: Nobody is waiting to accept an invitation.
teamNobody: Nobody else has an account yet.
teamFailed: We could not load your team
teamFailedNote: Nothing has changed. Try again in a moment.
teamInviteNote: They receive a single-use link. It expires in seven days, and you can resend or revoke it until they use it.
teamEmailHint: Must be on one of your company email domains. Ask your Noatum office to invite anyone else.
teamRolesHint: Pick one or more. You can change this at any time.
teamInviteLink: Email is not configured here, so pass this link on yourself:
teamResendExhausted: This invitation has been resent three times. Revoke it and send a new one.
teamReasonHint: Recorded against your company audit, so a change can be explained later.
quotesIntro: Every quote, whether you requested it or we prepared it for you. The bar shows what is waiting on you.
quotesSearch: Search by reference, route or your own number
quotesEmpty: You have not requested a quote yet.
progStatusWaiting: We are working on your request. Nothing is needed from you yet.
progStatusWithdrawn: This request has been withdrawn and no further pricing work will continue.
progSubtitle: Follow each stage from submission to a quotation ready for your decision.
progStageNote_requested: We received the request and routed it to the Noatum office serving your account.
progStageNote_claimed: A pricing specialist has taken ownership and is checking the request.
progStageNote_priced: The pricing team is preparing one or more options, with validity and transit details.
progStageNote_confirmed: The quotation has passed the configured operating-system confirmation step.
progStageNote_ready: Your options are published and ready to compare and accept.
progAwaitNote: Pricing is handled by people. We will publish the options when they are complete.
progDeskNote: The servicing office owns this request. Use your usual Noatum contact if something material changes.
progDeskNoteStopped: The servicing office has been told to stop work on this request.
progTip_1: Pricing may ask for a missing detail before options can be prepared.
progTip_2: The option validity starts when the quotation is published, not while it is being prepared.
progTip_3: You can review the submitted request at any time without changing it.
quotePendingQueued: Your request is with the pricing team of your servicing branch. The first available specialist will pick it up.
quotePendingClaimed: A pricing specialist is preparing your options, with transit times, validity and free time. Typically one working day.
quoteOptionExpired: This option has passed its validity date.
quoteAcceptNote: We will confirm and prepare the booking. You can still talk to us before anything moves.
quoteDeclineNote: The whole quotation is declined. You can always request a new one.
quoteDeclineReasonHint: Optional. It helps us quote better next time.
quoteCancelNote: The request is withdrawn from the pricing queue and whoever is working on it is told to stop.
aiGreeting: Hello. Tell me what you need to move and I will prepare the request for you. You can write it in your own words, or attach an invoice, packing list or purchase order.
aiStepRoute: Matching the route and the Incoterm…
aiHere: Here is what I have so far.
aiConfirmAsk: Shall I fill in the request with this?
aiApplied: Done. I have filled in the request below, and every field is yours to change.
aiDiscarded: Left as it was. Tell me what to change and we can try again.
aiReady: The request below is ready. Please review it and send it when you are happy.
aiStillNeed: The request still needs you: {{list}}. I have filled in what I could.
aiPastePlaceholder: For example: 2 pallets of furniture from Qingdao to Valencia, about 1,200 kg, ready next Friday, FOB
aiMorePlaceholder: Anything else you would like to change?
aiNotConfigured: I cannot reach my reading service at the moment. Please fill in the request below and I will stay out of your way.
aiUnreadable: I could not make enough of that. Could you tell me the origin, the destination and roughly what you are shipping?
aiProvenance: Drafted by the agent — please check every field.
reqServiceHint: Mode, direction and what we handle
reqReadyDateEmpty: Choose the day the cargo is ready to collect.
reqRouteHint: Where it starts and where it must arrive
reqPartiesHint: Who ships, who receives, your own numbers
reqJourneyNote: Transit times come with your quote: a specialist confirms them per option.
reqBlocked_card-service: Choose a service, a scope and the named place for your Incoterm
reqBlocked_card-route: Origin, destination or the ready date is missing
reqDateOrderError: Latest delivery cannot be before the cargo is ready.
reqNamedPlaceHint: The place the Incoterm refers to, e.g. Qingdao port or a Madrid warehouse.
reqUnlocodeHint: Search by port, city or country, e.g. Valencia or Spain
reqPortNoMatch: No match yet. A 5-character UN/LOCODE is still accepted.
reqPortPrompt: Keep typing. You can search by port, city or country.
reqComboFreeText: No match. It will be sent as typed and read by a pricing specialist.
reqCompleteLabel: How much of the request is complete
reqVolumeCalculated: Volume is calculated from the dimensions, never typed.
reqHandling_outOfGauge: Out of gauge or heavy lift
tempIntro: The set point travels with the booking and appears on the reefer manifest. A specialist confirms ventilation and pre-cooling against your commodity.
tempToleranceHint: Zero means no tolerance at all
oogTitle: Out of gauge and heavy lift
oogIntro: Add every oversized or heavy piece, not only the longest or the heaviest. Lifting equipment is quoted per piece.
oogEmpty: No piece added yet. Add at least one so we can quote the lifting.
oogLiftingHint: Leave unknown and we will advise
oogSumTitle: Out of gauge and heavy lift
eqNoTypes: No container types are available. Please contact us to arrange this shipment.
eqPayloadUnknown: We hold no payload figure for this type.
eqOverPayload: Above the usual payload for this type. We will confirm what the container and the road leg allow.
dgPricerHint: Declared by the customer. Check it against the carrier's acceptance rules before you price.
dgCustomerHint: What you declared with this request.
dgIntro: Tell us what is travelling so a specialist can price it and confirm the carrier will accept it. This is not a dangerous goods declaration; we will arrange that with you before the shipment is tendered.
dgEmpty: Add one entry for each UN number, and one more where the same substance travels in a different packaging.
dgUnNumberHint: Four digits, from your safety data sheet
dgClassHint: Pick from the list or type the division
dgSubsidiaryRiskHint: A further hazard the substance also presents
dgProperShippingNameHint: As it appears on your safety data sheet
dgPackingGroupHint: Leave as not assigned where the entry has none
dgTechnicalNameHint: Where the shipping name ends in n.o.s.
dgRegimeHint: Limited and excepted quantities change what is needed later
dgNoLines: Add a cargo line first, then say which one holds this entry.
dgLinkRequired: Select the cargo holding this entry. We need to know which packages carry the hazard.
dgFootnote: A specialist reviews these details with you before anything is booked. Please check them against your safety data sheet; the applicable transport regulations govern what may be carried, and the dangerous goods declaration is raised separately.
reqCargoValueHint: Used for customs, and for insurance if you asked for it.
reqCustomerReferenceHint: Purchase order or your own number
reqNotesHint: Preferred carriers, free time needed, anything unusual.
reqReadyNote: Everything a pricing specialist needs is here.
reqIncompleteNote: Finish the outstanding sections to send.
reqSendNote: Sent to the pricing queue of your servicing branch.
reqLatestDeliveryEmpty: Choose the last day it can arrive.
reqCountryOfOriginHint: Where the goods were made, which can differ from where they ship from. It sets the customs duty.
dgComboFreeText: No match — it will be sent as typed.
reqNotesPh: Preferred carriers, free time needed, a target rate, anything unusual about this shipment
quotesPipelineNote_waiting: {{count}} waiting on your decision · pick a segment to filter
quotesFootnote: Quotes are held for the validity shown. After that a new rate has to be confirmed with the carrier.
quickIntro: Four answers and we start pricing. Use the full request when you need Incoterms, parties, special handling or dangerous goods.
quickHazardousNote: Dangerous goods need a UN number, a class and a packing group before we can price them. Declare them on the
quickFootnote: We reply with priced options. Anything this form does not ask, a pricing specialist will confirm with you.
quickFailed: The request could not be sent. Try again, or use the full request form.
denied: You do not have access to this
optCompareNote: Price, transit, departures, free time, validity and what is included
optAcceptNote: Accepting freezes this quotation and tells your Noatum office. You can then book from it.
optDecidedAcceptedNote: Accepted {{date}}. Your Noatum office will be in touch to book it.
optDecidedDeclinedNote: Your Noatum office has been told.
optRejectNote: Telling us why means the desk can re-price instead of guessing.
optReason_cancelled: The shipment is no longer going ahead
optNotePlaceholder: Target rate, the transit you need, a competing offer
optAskRevision: Ask your Noatum office for a revised quotation
optDownloadPending: Downloading and copying are not available yet. Your Noatum office can send you the quotation in the meantime.
optReqNoServices: You did not ask for any additional services.
optReqNoHandling: You did not declare any special handling.
instIntro: Four fields and the request reaches the office that serves you, where a specialist prices it by hand.
instNoPermission: Your account cannot raise quotation requests. Ask an administrator on your team.
instLoadEmpty: Sea LCL, Sea FCL or Air
instFootnote: Nothing is committed by asking. Every quotation carries a validity date, and you choose from the options before anything is booked.
instFailed: The request could not be sent. Try again in a moment.
instViaPortHint: The lane is what gets priced, so we still need the terminal it moves through.
instDockNote: otherwise a chassis drop or side-loader is quoted
instServicePrompt: Choose a service and we will ask for the right cargo detail.
instDoorContainerNote: Door collection or delivery of a full container needs a loading dock, or space for a chassis drop at the address.
instHazardousNote: A hazard needs its UN number, class, packing group and quantities before anyone can price or carry it, so this request has to be made on the full form.
instValidityNote: Every quotation shows a validity date. Prices can change if the cargo is not gated in before it.
instRecentNote: The last few lanes you asked about.
instRecentEmpty: Nothing yet. The first request you send appears here.
instFullNote: Dangerous goods, temperature control, out-of-gauge pieces, parties, customs data and add-on services are on the full request form.
reqStepFillNote: Fill in this step to continue.
reqHint_card-service: Tell us how it should move and what we should handle
reqHint_card-route: Where it starts, where it must arrive and when
reqHint_card-cargo: What is in it, and anything that needs special handling
reqHint_card-parties: Who ships, who receives, and your own numbers
reqFieldRequired: This is needed to price the request.
reqNeedNamedPlace: Say where the Incoterm applies, for example Qingdao port.
reqNeedPort: Choose a port or airport, or type its 5-character UN/LOCODE.
reqPortMore: {{count}} more ports and airports. Type a name, a code or a country to narrow it.
reqListMore: {{count}} more. Keep typing to narrow the list.
